Name: Pinzon Fleur Jacquard Egyptian Cotton Sateen 18-By-18-Inch Pillow Cover, French Blue/Chocolate
Colors: French Blue/Chocolate
Materials: Cotton
Decorative pillow cover with an elegant Jacquard floral pattern; made in Portugal Made of 100-percent Egyptian cotton in a Sateen weave; 1-ply yarns; side slit opening Positive/negative reverse, with blue piping; coordinates with Pinzon Fleur Jacquard collection Machine washable and dryable; available in a choice of colors Measures 18 by 18 inches
